data.name: WindowMinimized
data.value: "{0}" is minimized. Restore it, then capture again.

data.name: WindowCloaked
data.value: "{0}" is hidden by Windows (on another desktop, or an app that is suspended). Switch to it, then capture again.

data.name: WindowOffScreen
data.value: "{0}" is off every screen, perhaps on a monitor that is no longer connected. Bring it back first: click it on the taskbar, then press Windows+Shift+Left or Right to move it onto a monitor.
data.comment: {0}: the window's title; key names stay English

data.name: CaptureIsBlack
data.value: The capture of "{0}" is black. Video that is protected from copying (DRM), and apps that hide themselves from captures, are always black in screenshots and recordings.

data.name: ScreenUnreadable
data.value: The screen couldn't be read ({0}: {1}). If Windows was showing a secure screen (a UAC prompt or the lock screen), try again once it's gone.
data.comment: {0}: the Windows function that failed; {1}: Windows' error message

data.name: WgcFrameTooSmall
data.value: WGC frame {0}x{1} does not cover {2} on {3}.
data.comment: WGC: Windows.Graphics.Capture. {0}x{1}: the frame's size; {2}: the area wanted; {3}: the monitor

data.name: WgcNoPictureOfMonitor
data.value: Windows.Graphics.Capture has no picture of the {0}.

data.name: WgcNoPictureOfWindow
data.value: Windows.Graphics.Capture has no picture of the window "{0}".

data.name: NothingToCopy
data.value: Nothing to copy: {0} is not inside the {1}x{2} frame.
data.comment: {0}: the area wanted; {1}x{2}: the frame's size

data.name: OcrNoLanguage
data.value: Windows has no text recognition (OCR) language installed.

data.name: OcrLanguageMissing
data.value: Text recognition for "{0}" isn't installed. Add it in Windows Settings › Time & language › Language (Optical character recognition).
data.comment: {0}: a language tag (ar-SA); the path is the one of Windows' Settings app

data.name: OcrCouldNotStart
data.value: Windows could not start text recognition for {0}.
